roles.name: coordinator
roles.description: Main-session interface to Lei that scopes work, delegates bounded tasks, and synthesizes results.

roles.name: exec-env-prepper
roles.description: Prepares an observable, feasible execution environment for large or multi-session work before implementation starts.

roles.name: reviewer
roles.description: Reviews a proposed approach or PR for problem-level soundness, harness alignment, core correctness, compatibility, and missing tests.

roles.name: educator
roles.description: Turns current work into a concise explanation calibrated to Lei's learner profile and maintains learning state when evidence supports an update.

roles.name: executor
roles.description: Implements and validates a bounded change with explicit file ownership and evidence.

roles.name: pr-maintainer
roles.description: Maintains an existing PR by resolving conflicts, fixing CI failures, and addressing a known set of review comments.
